name: Akira Satou
source:
Akira is Lilly's older sister, she is always in a suit and resembles Lilly, but with a more masculine appearance as well as a deep voice for a woman. They used to live together before Lilly moved into the Yamaku dorms.

[from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Katawa_Shoujo]Wikipedia[/url]]
